description: This is a Java class defining an Android Fragment called 'ArticleFragment' which manages and displays an article view, handling state preservation and argument-based updates.

classes.name: ArticleFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays an article based on input arguments or saved state, managing its view and lifecycle events.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout and restores state if available.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Checks for arguments or saved state to update the article view accordingly.

methods.name: updateArticleView
methods.description: Updates the TextView with the article content corresponding to the given position.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current article position for state restoration.
